title: Vision Exam Failure Rate
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vision:exam
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(exam_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by provider_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often vision exam records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each provider.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize exam_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per provider.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which parts of your vision exam data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
